findings: The Philharmonie de Paris pedagogical bibliography identifies alto saxophone and piano, Leduc AL20976, duration 1:40 and date 1952.

That bibliography describes a lively 6/8 miniature, mainly two-note slurs, accents, dotted rhythms and a written low-G to high-F-sharp span. These are source-reported observations, not direct score inspection.
Québec's conservatoire external curriculum includes the work in its preconservatory repertoire. It warrants a pre-college teaching-context flag.
